headline: Mooring County Front Erupts as Clashes Flare in Pari Peak
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, base turnover has surged across Mooring County, where six strategic shifts in the past two hours around MacConmara Barrows and The Wind Hills accompanied nearly 1,500 fresh casualties, leaving the sector divided between seven Warden positions, four Colonial holds, and one ruined outpost. Fighting has also ignited in Pari Peak, recording four rapid base exchanges at Little Raakkua over the last two hours before settling under Warden control. In Weathered Expanse, where ninety-one transitions have marked the past day, base exchanges slowed to a single event during the past two hours, though bloodshed remains severe with more than 1,500 casualties logged in the interval. Stlican Shelf registered another base turnover around Breaker Town and Briar, whereas Palantine Berm has quieted after earlier clashes at The Pippeli Stones. Meanwhile, heavy casualty tolls continue to mount without territorial shifts in Nevish Line, Dead Lands, and Linn of Mercy.
